embedded TPM</h1><p>In this situation, KEK keys are safely stored on TPMs on each of the three k8s server nodes. Each k8s server node needs to have the same KEK on each TPM. Indeed, the "Raft leader" cluster randomly generates a DEK seed (32 bytes) which will be stored as an encrypted object in its ETCD database. Then the content of the ETCD DB is synchronised and propagated to the other k8s server nodes.<br></p><p>If one server node (e.g. the Raft leader) crashes and fails, then other server nodes will need to be able to decrypt the DEK in case of cluster reboot. Therefore, each cluster node needs to have access to the same KEK.</p>" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;spacing=5;spacingTop=-20;whiteSpace=wrap;overflow=hidden;rounded=0;" parent="XgJSQenSK-BKa7MVUS-T-1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="220" y="500" width="580" height="200" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> <diagram name="USB HSM 3 master nodes" id="KXWXaJomAVvqf_tPnyuR"> <mxGraphModel dx="942" dy="1049" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="kfQ9eIouwYP7pa8gA-Im-0" /> <mxCell id="kfQ9eIouwYP7pa8gA-Im-1" parent="kfQ9eIouwYP7pa8gA-Im-0" /> <mxCell id="kfQ9eIouwYP7pa8gA-Im-2" style="rounded=0;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;entryX=0;entryY=0.5;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;entryPerimeter=0;exitX=0.913;exitY=0.002;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;exitPerimeter=0;" parent="kfQ9eIouwYP7pa8gA-Im-1" source="kfQ9eIouwYP7pa8gA-Im-3" target="kfQ9eIouwYP7pa8gA-Im-50" edge="1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="kfQ9eIouwYP7pa8gA-Im-3" value="k3s Server Node #01

USB HSM</h1><p>In this situation, KEK keys are safely stored on TPMs on each of the three k8s server nodes. Each k8s server node needs to have the same KEK on each USB HSM. Indeed, the "Raft leader" cluster randomly generates a DEK seed (32 bytes) which will be stored as an encrypted object in its ETCD database. Then the content of the ETCD DB is synchronised and propagated to the other k8s server nodes.<br></p><p>If one server node (e.g. the Raft leader) crashes and fails, then other server nodes will need to be able to decrypt the DEK in case of cluster reboot. Therefore, each cluster node needs to have access to the same KEK.</p>" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;spacing=5;spacingTop=-20;whiteSpace=wrap;overflow=hidden;rounded=0;" Each k8s server node needs to have the same KEK. Indeed, the "Raft leader" cluster randomly generates a DEK seed (32 bytes) which will be stored as an encrypted object in its ETCD database. Then the content of the ETCD DB is synchronised and propagated to the other k8s server nodes.<br></p><p>If one server node (e.g. the Raft leader) crashes and fails, then other server nodes will need to be able to decrypt the DEK in case of cluster reboot. Therefore, each cluster node needs to have access to the same KEK.</p>" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;spacing=5;spacingTop=-20;whiteSpace=wrap;overflow=hidden;rounded=0;"
